2.88.53
Chart.ToolTip
The Chart.ToolTip element specifies the textual label for a Chart. The element can also be used to
render alternative text (alt text) that is specified as an alt attribute in an HTML report. The
Chart.ToolTip element is optional. If the Chart.ToolTip element is present, its value MUST be a
String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String. If the
Chart.ToolTip element is not present, its value is interpreted as an empty string.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.ToolTip element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.ToolTip element in RDL 2003/10 and
RDL 2005/01.
 <xsd:element name="ToolTip" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.ToolTip element in RDL 2008/01,
RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01.
 <xsd:element name="ToolTip" type="StringLocIDType" minOccurs="0" />
